mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals stronger household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods where HOUST declines by more than 10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) above 4% signals stronger demand and higher earnings expectations, which drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods where RSAFS growth exceeds 4% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Industrial Production exceeding 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods where INDPRO declines by more than 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 3% signals tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 3% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 0.4% signals weaker labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods where UNRATE rises by more than 0.4% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in GDP growth above 1.5% signals stronger economic activity and higher corporate earnings, which drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
